foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat $100.00 filing fee for the Limited Liability Company Registration for a non-Maryland LLC; a written proof of existence from the home state must accompany the registration.
foreignQualification.formName: Limited Liability Company Registration (For non-Maryland Limited Liability Company)
foreignQualification.filedWith: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation, Charter Division
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report on or before April 15 each year and maintain a resident agent for service of process in Maryland.

evidence.quote: LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY REGISTRATION (For non-Maryland Limited Liability Company) (Filing fee $100)
Maryland Department of Assessments and Taxation Charter Division
If no Resident Agent is named or if the agent cannot be found or served, this Department is appointed as Resident Agent of this Limited Liability Company for no additional fee.
All domestic and foreign business entities should file their 2026 reports, or request a 60 day extension to file, on or before April 15, 2026.

Forms for non-Maryland businesses Foreign Corporation Qualification form Application for Registration of a Foreign Limited Partnership Foreign Corporation Assumed Name form and instructions Foreign Limited Liability Partnership Registration Foreign Limited Liability Company Registration

notes: Collected on the VPN-up route. The official form (rev. August 2024) states the $100.00 filing fee and the home-state proof-of-existence requirement; the SDAT fee schedule for charter services (rev. May 2024) lists LLC registration at $100 (foreign). The form is filed with the Charter Division of the State Department of Assessments and Taxation, 700 East Pratt Street, Suite 2700, Baltimore, Maryland 21202.
